change_summary: Adds the Precalculus unit (11 skills, 88 questions: domain and range, composition, inverse functions, polynomial behaviour, rational functions, exponentials, logarithms and their rules, exponential equations, sequences and series) and the Trigonometry unit (12 skills, 98 questions: right-triangle ratios, sine/cosine/tangent, finding sides and angles, applications, exact values from the special triangles, radians, the unit circle, reference angles, trig graphs and their transformations, and identities). Completes the arithmetic-to-trigonometry path. Introduces the exact_value question type for surds and multiples of pi.
